other_conditions: Family must not own more than 3 acres of agricultural land or more than one residential house.
Applicant must not have availed any other government loan or subsidy.
Applicant must have a viable business plan or entrepreneurial idea.
Applicant must be willing to contribute 10% of the project cost.
Applicant must have a bank account.
Applicant must have a digital identity (e.g., Aadhaar).
Applicant must have passed at least the 10th standard.
Applicant must not have a criminal record or conviction.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time grant of Rs. 10 lakh to eligible SC families to start a business, promoting entrepreneurship and income generation.
documents_required: Viable business plan or entrepreneurial idea
